task.name: Assemble_camp_arch
task.when: During Build after the public entrance is approved

step.action: Confirm the arch drawing, lift sequence, connection, anchor, carpet, and lighting plan in 📦 Build_Book.
Assemble the arch on the ground in the printed sequence.
Raise the arch only on the Build Lead's command.
Install every connection, brace, strap, and anchor shown in the drawing.
Unroll and secure the red carpet without creating a raised edge.
Have the Power Lead install and test the arch lighting.

passWhen.criterion: The arch matches the current drawing and is fully anchored.
The carpet is secured without a trip edge.
The lighting operates and its cable route is protected.
The entrance and emergency route are clear.
